name: Catch certificate needed (IUU)
pageTitle: Catch certificates - Import and export applications - GOV.UK
caption: Documents
heading: Catch certificates
bodyCopy: You must add catch certificates for all fish species unless they are exempt from illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing controls.
For help with catch certificates, check the guidance on importing or moving fish into the UK (opens in new tab).
If you do not have catch certificates now
If catch certificates are missing or incomplete, the consignment is at high risk of being rejected.
Make sure you provide all required documents for this notification promptly to avoid disruptions and delays in the clearance process.

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Custom IPAFFS link styling appears on both the guidance anchor ('importing or moving fish into the UK (opens in new tab).') and the details summary text ('If you do not have catch certificates now') — it removes the default underline and applies a hover highlight.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Not GOV.UK Design System classes; overrides standard govuk-link styling and works against the Design System's accessibility guidance that links should be underlined.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: Use a plain govuk-link with default underlined styling; no custom link classes needed.
nonStandardPatterns.evidence: trace db2d277c5c8bfcf2dc0f2278bc92dc7aa8fdf42d action 38 after snapshot (guidance anchor class="govuk-link link-no-underline link-hover-highlight"; details summary span class="govuk-details__summary-text link-no-underline link-hover-highlight")

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: IPAFFS layout modifier positioning the back link next to breadcrumbs.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Non-standard modifier on govuk-back-link; positioning tweak specific to IPAFFS page furniture.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: Standard govuk-back-link placed above the page heading per the Design System pattern.

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Page renders both 'Catch certificates' (govuk-heading-xl) and 'Do you need to add catch certificates?' (govuk-heading-l) as <h1>.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Two H1s on a single page violates HTML heading hierarchy and the GOV.UK question-page pattern. The govuk-fieldset__legend is empty, so the radios' accessible grouping label is not the visible question heading.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: Single H1; make the question the fieldset legend (using govuk-fieldset__legend--l with the H1 inside it) per the GOV.UK 'question pages' pattern, or demote the question to an <h2>.

validationMessages.message: Select if you need to add catch certificates
validationMessages.trigger: Submit without selecting Yes or No
validationMessages.evidence: Verbatim CATCH_CERTIFICATE_NEEDED_LABEL copy in the authorised legacy constants, mapped to the required radio field by the page Joi validator (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/utils/validation_constants.js:15-18; service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/catch_certificate_exemption.js:20-29). The handler also uses the same copy when the documents page links back with fromDocuments=true (service/src/routes/handlers/importer/catch_certificate_exemption.js:107-115).

openQuestions: This is an IUU (fish) boundary page that has moved to a separate IUU journey. Preserve the behaviour and copy captured here, but confirm the hand-off contract and whether this page should be implemented or owned outside the core CHED-P journey.

The radio inputs have no HTML required attribute and the 'no option chosen' state was never exercised in the trace, but the authorised legacy Joi validator enforces a selection server-side and supplies the copy "Select if you need to add catch certificates" (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/catch_certificate_exemption.js:20-29). The IUU handoff should confirm whether to retain this exact copy.

The visible URL/slug is 'catch-certificates' (plural), the field name is 'catch-certificate-needed', and returnUrl points to '/catch-certificates'. Selecting 'Yes' presumably routes to a catch-certificate document-add flow; that downstream page is a separate spec.
Two <h1> elements and an empty fieldset legend — confirm intended heading structure for the rebuild.

The 'No' option copy is specifically about wild fish exempt from IUU controls, while the QA fish workflow reaches this page after selecting type 'Farmed stock' with species 'Anguilla spp.' (workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:866-900; types/commodity-type.ts:4; types/species.ts:10). Confirm the exact commodity/species condition that surfaces the IUU boundary and whether the option wording is correct for farmed-stock consignments.
